About the job
Mainbogen is an SAP consultancy with 140 consultants in Frankfurt, Cologne and Munich. We help banks, insurers and industrial companies with SAP S/4HANA Finance, from the first design workshop to go-live and beyond. Our working language is English, as more than a third of our team comes from outside Germany.

For our Finance practice we are hiring a Junior SAP FI/CO Consultant on a permanent contract.

What you will do
- Support our senior consultants in S/4HANA Finance implementation and conversion projects
- Configure SAP FI (general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, asset accounting) and CO (cost centre accounting, internal orders)
- Prepare test cases, run tests and document the results
- Help with data migration tasks such as data cleansing and preparing load files
- Join workshops with our clients' finance teams and take over your first small work packages on your own

What you bring
- A degree in business administration, business informatics or a similar field
- 1 to 3 years of experience with SAP FI/CO, for example from a first consulting job, an in-house SAP team, a dual study programme or a working student position
- A basic understanding of accounting processes (HGB and/or IFRS)
- First experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus; an SAP certification is welcome but not required
- Very good English; German at B1 level or higher
- Willingness to travel to clients in Germany for up to 30 % of your time

What we offer
- A permanent full-time contract with a gross annual salary of EUR 54,000 to 62,000, depending on your experience
- A structured 12-month training path including the SAP certification for S/4HANA Financial Accounting
- A personal mentor from our senior team
- Hybrid work with up to three days per week from home
- 30 days of holiday, a public transport ticket, a company pension scheme and a modern office near the main station
- Team events, a yearly offsite and plenty of good coffee

We look forward to your application in English or German. Your contact: Leonie Brandstätter, Talent Acquisition.
